'''Tre'vor Kirieleison''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He became affiliated with the [[White Maw]] pirates on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] around [[3641 BBY]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tre'vor Kirieleison appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. He is not directly involved in any quests, however he can be killed by characters of both factions for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
